_comment: Defaults target production (dash.datagateapp.com + Desktop OAuth client). Override for self-hosted API or another Google client. OpenVpn.IgnoreRedirectGateway=true avoids full-tunnel; UdpBridgeFramed=false if UDP VPN fails with TLS errors; UseSystemBinary=true (embedded build) uses system openvpn. Update: GitHub releases/latest check. No client secret in this file.
